tips.text: Switch to Mobile Defense at Kiste or Hijack on Ceres if Nuovo stays quiet; alarms are already on and Prosecutors keep arriving.
Abort and rerun when no Prosecutor shows up instead of sitting through a dry mission.
Trigger the alarms before you enter the Nuovo vault; the Prosecutor only patrols once they are on.
Avoid plain Exterminate or Spy for this; Grineer often run to the console without ever triggering the alarm.
Skip resource and drop chance boosters here; they do not apply to Capacitors.
Hold a Capture target in a late room at Ludi and let Prosecutors come to you; hauls vary from none to several.
Bring Valkyr; Hysteria finishers kill Prosecutors fast.
Change host or squad after a long dry spell; Prosecutors reportedly spawned right away under a higher-rank host.
Start the Detonite Injector research first and farm Capacitors while the 3-day research timers run.
Treat Javlok as mastery fodder; the weapon is widely called mediocre, and the Capacitor farm is a short detour.
